register_file_assets: register file-based asset metadata sources from a directory path into a dependency container
register_package_assets: register package-based asset metadata sources from a Python package into a dependency container
register_in_memory_assets: register in-memory asset metadata entries as a named source in a dependency container
register_checkpoint_models: register model checkpoint files from a directory as asset metadata sources in a container
register_asset: register all standard asset store, metadata, and download manager types in a dependency container
